exposure: time of death in relation to the delivery
cohort: This study included mothers whose babies were born and resided in Teresina, Brazil between 2010 and 2014 and experienced a perinatal death.
finding: The study found that perinatal mortality was statistically correlated with gestational age, birth weight, and type of delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that vaginal delivery was more common among perinatal deaths.
